metadata.title: Big Three Playstyle Clustering
metadata.interpretation: Exploratory associations; clustering does not prove intrinsic player archetypes.

executive_summary_cards.working_archetype: Fast-court net attacker: a working interpretation emphasizing first-strike serving, attacking shot mix, and net play.
executive_summary_cards.model_scope: Exploratory clustering of charted player-matches from 2010-2022 across Hard, Clay, and Grass.
executive_summary_cards.caveat: Archetype wording is interpretive, not a supervised model label or proof of a fixed style.

metadata.plot_orientation: Vertical court; x-axis is width/Y, y-axis is length/X; player is normalized to the server baseline and receiver to the opposite end.
metadata.direction_semantics: Digits 1/2/3 target opponent right/center/left; target hand labels forehand/backhand side.
metadata.position_semantics: Workbook defaults and explicit -/= markers infer shot origins.
metadata.depth_semantics: 7/8/9 map service-box/mid/deep return zones; absent depth is projected baseline crossing.
metadata.interpretation: Point-code reconstructed proxies, not tracking coordinates; defaults and missing depths are estimates.

clutch_survival_analysis.method: Pooled point-level logistic regression with player fixed effects, player-specific tiebreak effects, and match-clustered sandwich standard errors.
clutch_survival_analysis.period: 2005 onward, restricted to charted matches represented in master_player_match.

outcomes.break_point: Server wins the point while facing a reconstructed break point.
outcomes.tiebreak_point: Player wins the point in a reconstructed tiebreak; each point contributes one row per Big Three participant.

clutch_survival_analysis.inference: Odds ratios and 95% Wald confidence intervals use match-clustered standard errors; player break-point odds are conditional on Hard court, set 1, average preceding-point shot count, and non-deciding set.
clutch_survival_analysis.prediction_profile: Best-of-five Hard-court match; average preceding-point shot count; deciding-set indicator is set only in set 5.

model_coefficients.Variable / Player: Each additional shot in preceding point

surface_adaptability_score.method: Non-ML custom composite score from unweighted variance of surface win rates around overall win rate and weakest-surface win rate.
surface_adaptability_score.period: 2005 onward, restricted to player-match rows with a known winner and Clay, Grass, or Hard surface.

formula.surface_deviation_variance: ((Clay rate - overall rate)^2 + (Grass rate - overall rate)^2 + (Hard rate - overall rate)^2) / 3
